memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: routine follow‑up of epilepsy, vitamin B12 deficiency and hypothyroidism.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports no seizures in the past month, mild fatigue, no neck pain or heat intolerance.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/78 mmHg, weight 72 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 25.5 (obese). Cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal, no tremor, gait steady.
IMPRESSION: Epilepsy well controlled on levetiracetam and lamotrigine. Vitamin B12 deficiency being replaced. Hypothyroidism stable; TSH to be checked. Advised weight reduction diet and daily walking.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, serum B12, MCV, Hb, TSH, free T4, serum Na, creatinine. Continue current meds. Influenza vaccine not due (spring). Return if: seizure activity, fever >39°C, chest pain, palpitations, severe fatigue, swelling of legs, or dark urine.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: 3‑month review of epilepsy, B12 deficiency and hypothyroidism.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: No seizure breakthrough, occasional mild tiredness, denies palpitations or heat intolerance.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, weight 71.5 kg, BMI 25.3 (obese). No goiter, normal cardiac rhythm, fine tremor absent.
IMPRESSION: Seizure control satisfactory. B12 level low‑normal, continue replacement. TSH slightly elevated, indicating suboptimal thyroid replacement; increase levothyroxine. Advise continued calorie control and brisk walk 30 mins daily.
ARRANGEMENTS: Repeat TSH, free T4, B12, MCV, Hb, Na, creatinine. Increase levothyroxine to 75 mcg OD. Influenza vaccine not due. Return if: new seizures, worsening fatigue, weight gain, palpitations, heat intolerance, leg swelling, or urine changes.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of recent light‑headedness and ongoing chronic disease management.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient describes episodic dizziness on standing, no syncope, denies chest pain or palpitations.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/70 mmHg (standing), weight 71 kg, BMI 25.2 (obese). No orthostatic hypotension >20 mmHg drop, pulse regular.
IMPRESSION: Mild orthostatic dizziness possibly related to levetiracetam; epilepsy otherwise controlled. B12 and thyroid labs pending. Advise adequate hydration, rise slowly, and monitor symptoms.
ARRANGEMENTS: Check serum sodium, creatinine, and consider lowering levetiracetam dose. Give influenza vaccine today (2025-10-20) as patient is >60 yr. Return if: dizziness worsens, fainting, seizure, fever >39°C, palpitations, chest pain, or swelling of ankles.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: annual review of epilepsy, B12 deficiency, hypothyroidism and preventive care.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: No seizures, dizziness resolved, feels well, no cold intolerance.
EXAMINATION: BP 126/78 mmHg, weight 70.5 kg, BMI 25.0 (obese). No thyroid enlargement, normal heart sounds.
IMPRESSION: Epilepsy stable on reduced levetiracetam. B12 now within low‑normal range, continue replacement. TSH within target on levothyroxine 75 mcg. Order fasting lipid profile and fasting blood sugar as per annual schedule. Advise maintain weight, regular exercise.
ARRANGEMENTS: Order fasting lipids and FBS. Continue current meds. Influenza vaccine status: given 2025-10-20 (autumn). Return if: seizure, new neurological symptoms, unexplained weight change, palpitations, chest pain, breathlessness, or leg swelling.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason for visit: review of lipid and FBS results and ongoing chronic disease management.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports feeling good, no seizures, no dizziness, denies chest pain or breathlessness.
EXAMINATION: BP 124/76 mmHg, weight 70 kg, BMI 24.8 (overweight). No thyroid enlargement, normal cardiovascular exam.
IMPRESSION: Lipids: total cholesterol 4.8 mmol/L (ref <5.2), LDL 2.9 mmol/L (ref <2.6) – slightly elevated, HDL 1.2 mmol/L (ref >1.0). FBS 5.6 mmol/L (ref 3.9‑5.5) – mildly elevated. Continue lifestyle advice, consider statin if LDL persists >2.6 after 3 months. Epilepsy, B12, thyroid stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Repeat lipid profile and FBS in 3 months. Reinforce diet low in saturated fats, increase physical activity. Influenza vaccine not due (summer). Return if: chest pain, palpitations, breathlessness, seizure activity, unexplained weight loss/gain, or leg edema.
